items.title: How Much Do You Really Need Invested to Replace a $75,000 Salary With Dividends?
items.summary: The yield you chase to replace a salary can quietly destroy the purchasing power you built to protect. Before you settle on a number, understand what the tradeoff between yield and dividend growth actually costs you over a decade.

items.title: TMUS Stock Is On Track For A Second Month Of Gains, But This Analyst Sees ‘New Pressures’ Ahead
items.summary: Wolfe Research analyst Peter Supino downgraded T-Mobile US stock to ‘Peer Perform’ from ‘Outperform’ without a price target.

items.title: Tutor Perini (TPC) Stock Is Up, What You Need To Know
items.summary: Shares of general contracting company Tutor Perini (NYSE:TPC) jumped 2.7% in the afternoon session after the company landed a $42 million contract from the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) to complete construction of facilities at Tabuk Air Base in Saudi Arabia.

items.title: Tutor Perini (TPC) Stock May Be 34% Undervalued After Record Backlog News
items.summary: Tutor Perini stock has delivered a very large 3 year return while current valuation work suggests the shares still trade below an estimate of intrinsic value, so investors are weighing how much of the story is already in the price. Over the past 3 years, Tutor Perini has returned about 10.6x an initial investment, which puts recent price moves in sharp focus for anyone looking at new positions or adding exposure. items.title: 2 Industrials Stocks for Long-Term Investors and 1 We Brush Off
items.summary: Even if they go mostly unnoticed, industrial businesses are the backbone of our country. Still, their generally high capital requirements expose them to the ups and downs of economic cycles, and the industry’s six-month return of 2.9% has fallen short of the S&P 500’s 13.5% rise.

items.title: AT&T’s CMO tied ‘brand love’ to the numbers CEOs care about. Customers are 3 times less likely to leave and much cheaper to acquire
items.summary: AT&T’s CMO says customers who love the brand are three times less likely to leave, 50% more likely to buy a second product, and cheaper to acquire.

items.title: AST SpaceMobile vs. IBM: Which Tech Stock is the Better Buy Now?
items.summary: IBM's steadier earnings outlook and cheaper valuation outweigh ASTS' stronger stock gains, making it the relatively better investment option now.

items.title: Can AT&T's Disaster Connectivity Efforts Drive Customer Satisfaction?
items.summary: AT&T is preparing for Tropical Storm Lala in Hawaii, reinforcing its network and deploying disaster-response resources to help keep customers connected.
